ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_softmax_margin_advantage
ir.intuition: Shift from contrastive or sigmoid losses to a margin-based softmax paradigm that forms probabilities over the pair (winner and loser), scaled by advantage gap. This loss uses a softmax over log-probabilities with an explicit margin weighted by advantage difference, encouraging clear probabilistic separation with smooth gradients and better calibration.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
margin = adv_gap * margin_coef
logits = [log_prob_w, log_prob_l - margin]
prob_w = softmax(logits)[0]
loss = -log(prob_w) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    margin_coef = float(extra.get('margin_coef', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_coef', 1.0)))
    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.mul(adv_gap, margin_coef)
    logit_w = lpw
    logit_l = ops.sub(lpl, margin)
    logits = ops.stack([logit_w, logit_l], axis=0)  # shape [2, batch_size]
    max_logits = ops.maximum(logits[0], logits[1])
    exp_logits = ops.exp(ops.sub(logits, max_logits))
    sum_exp = ops.add(exp_logits[0], exp_logits[1])
    prob_w = ops.div(exp_logits[0], sum_exp)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.log(ops.clamp(prob_w, 1e-12, 1.0)))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
